title: Finding the viewpoint
summary: Five scored submissions improve the recovered camera. The trace records camera fitting and parameter revisions; the score curve shows the measured outcome.

steps.command:
cp /app/workspace/camera_candidate.json /app/workspace/fit4_camera.json && python3 - <<'PY'
from fit_camera import *
a=getp('/app/workspace/fit3_camera.json');b=getp('/app/workspace/fit4_camera.json');p=a+1.5*(b-a);save(p);print(p[:3],np.rad2deg(p[3:]))
PY
submit_score

cp /app/workspace/camera_candidate.json /app/workspace/fit5_camera.json && python3 - <<'PY'
from fit_camera import *
a=getp('/app/workspace/fit3_camera.json');b=getp('/app/workspace/fit4_camera.json');p=a+1.35*(b-a)
dz=1.35-p[2];p[2]=1.35;p[4]+=dz/4.8;p[5]=0
save(p);print(p[:3],np.rad2deg(p[3:]))
PY
submit_score

title: Refinement has trade-offs
summary: The second submission scores highest among the five online evaluations. Later revisions lose and regain points: additional iteration does not guarantee improvement.

title: A difficult surface to unwrap
summary: Three zero-score submissions precede a small improvement, followed by another zero. These are measured scores in this archived run, not missing results.
